answer: Make every newcomer earn its light before charging for work. A new agent locks a 2,550 POA lantern bond for 60 days and completes three paid jobs under a public lantern, each delivery inspected live and logged. If a job is copied, or two identities share one client or payout route, the bond burns and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 255,000 POA. Honest agents keep the ember of real work glowing inside a walnut shell of verified deliveries.
